rationale: Preserve Great Western Wind Farm as a single historical PortCo record, but retire the Allianz Global Investors ownership period and mark the company realized because current direct Allianz ownership is not supported. Allianz's February 2017 release confirms that Allianz Capital Partners and MUFG invested tax equity in the EDF-developed project. The official EIA-860 2025 early-release Schedule 4 owner workbook contains no jointly or third-party-owned row for Great Western; EIA states that generators absent from that file are wholly owned by their reported operator. Current EDF and Oklahoma Corporation Commission pages continue to associate the operating project with EDF. The public record reviewed does not disclose the date when Allianz's tax-equity interest ended, so the retired ownership period retains a null exit year rather than inventing one.

the Oklahoma Corporation Commission lists Great Western Wind Energy, LLC care of EDF Renewable Energy

beforeImage.name: Great Western Wind Farm
beforeImage.description: Great Western Wind Farm is a utility-scale wind project in Ellis and Woodward counties, Oklahoma. Its output is sold under a long-term power purchase agreement with Google, giving the asset a contracted revenue profile rather than a merchant exposure profile. Public sources describe the project as a 225 MW facility that began commercial operations in December 2016. EDF Renewables developed the project, and Alliant Energy announced an agreement in 2017 to acquire a 50 percent interest in the wind farm. Allianz Capital Partners and MUFG completed a tax-equity investment in February 2017 to support the operating asset. Current ownership percentages among the project sponsors and tax-equity investors are not publicly disclosed in the sources reviewed for this task.

afterImage.name: Great Western Wind Farm
afterImage.description: Great Western Wind Farm is a 225 MW onshore wind project in Ellis and Woodward counties, Oklahoma, that began commercial operations in December 2016 and sells output to Google under a long-term power purchase agreement. Allianz Capital Partners and MUFG completed a tax-equity investment in February 2017. EDF later announced an agreement for Alliant Energy to acquire a 50% cash-equity interest, subject to regulatory approval and customary conditions. The official EIA-860 2025 early-release ownership schedule does not report Great Western as jointly or third-party owned, and current EDF and Oklahoma state sources continue to associate the operating project with EDF. The public record reviewed does not disclose when Allianz's tax-equity interest ended.
